children: posted an increase in third-quarter revenue on Wednesday, driven by like-for-like sales growth and store expansion across its retail businesses in an increasingly competitive grocery market.
Investors have focused on whether Sonae's core supermarket business can sustain growth as competition intensifies, with Spanish supermarket chain Mercadona continuing to expand in Portugal.
The group's food retail unit MC, owner of the Continente supermarket chain and its largest business, gained market share during the quarter, supported by strong volume growth

Underlying EBITDA at MC increased despite higher energy and fuel costs, while Sonae said Continente continued to outperform the market through its loyalty programme, product range and digital channels

"In health and beauty, we maintained strong momentum, driven by robust like-for-like growth and continued expansion of Wells and Druni (beauty and cosmetics shops) in Spain and Portugal," CEO Claudia Azevedo said in a statement
Sonae posted a 7.4% year-on-year rise in quarterly revenue to €3.13 billion ($3.43 billion)
Net profit in the July-September period rose 25% year-on-year, amounting to €122 million
Underlying EBITDA for the group grew 10.7% to €346 million
